verdict.rationale: The evidence shows customer-initiated fiat-to-crypto purchases (quotes, buy frames, widget wallet-address prefill), off-ramp sells, and transaction-status webhooks. Nothing documents a developer-initiated stablecoin payout API that sends funds to a wallet address or stored recipient. The enterprise line about converting incoming fiat into stablecoins is an adjacent treasury capability, not a documented payout endpoint with settlement tracking.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send stablecoin payouts programmatically — pay a wallet address or stored recipient through the API with documented status tracking to final settlement
